name: Unvalidated additional-field proposal
units: Must be specified by a concrete proposal; no default physical unit is assigned.
evolution_equation: A proposed diffusion-decay equation; parameters and boundary conditions must be specified before numerical use.
coupling: A proposed coupling to an independently observable transport rate.
observable: A measurement not defined solely by the fitted model residual.
null_model: Known transport and reaction mechanisms with matched measurement noise.
discriminating_prediction: A preregistered difference from the null under a controlled perturbation.
failure_condition: No reproducible difference after sensitivity and confound checks.
